'''Choren 8 (September 8)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - [[Birgitte]] is ripped out of ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. [[Elayne]] bonds her as a [[Warder]]. [[Moghedien]] is injured. [[Liandrin]] is permanently shielded by Moghedien and left in [[Amador]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Weiramon]] brings his [[Tairen]] cavalry to [[Rand]]'s forces in [[Cairhien]]. [[Kin Tovere]]'s tower is completed.
